label.en: After the fleets of the Eternal Watchers are all destroyed

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]恒星系笼罩着诡异的光芒。[Root.GetName]突然出现在星系的某个区域，我们确信这里此前数代人甚至数千年间从未被星系文明造访过。

但等一下，我们的传感器发现了一个能量信号！该信号主要集中在星系中的第一颗行星上，这颗行星似乎不太可能支持生命，毕竟它距离中子星如此接近。但好像还有其他信号正在移动。它们直奔[Root.GetName]而去，武器随时准备开火！
texts.en:
An eerie glow lies over the [From.GetName] system. The [Root.GetName] has emerged in a sector of the galaxy surely not visited by any galactic civilization for generations - for millennia... if ever.

But wait - our sensors are reporting energy signatures! Most are concentrated on the first planet of the system, an unlikely candidate for life, considering its proximity to a neutron star. But there are others, mobile ones. They are careening towards the [Root.GetName], weapons charged!

label.zh: 摧毁“永恒守望者”的全部舰队之后
label.en: After the fleets of the Eternal Watchers are all destroyed

texts.zh: 我们已经击败了[fromfrom.System.GetName]的防御者。这个恒星系里的景象真是光怪陆离：固态物质几乎不存在，即便是小行星带都残破不堪，就像是被人彻底地开采枯竭了一般。一系列巨型装置按照特定的间距环绕着行星，而信号显示的那一颗孤零零的行星也许是人为制造的。其中释放出了强大的能量信号。如果有什么线索的话一定能在那里找到。
texts.en: We have defeated the defenders of [fromfrom.System.GetName]. The system is a curious sight: there is very little solid matter remaining in it - even its asteroid belts have a bedraggled look, as if they have been extensively mined. A series of large installations placed at regular intervals around the star, and there is a single planet that our readings suggest may be artificial in origin. Intense energy signals have been detected emanating from it. If answers are to be found, they will be there.

texts.zh: [From.Planet.System.GetName]恒星系中孤零零的这颗行星上住满了无人机。它们对我们毫不关心，各自匆匆忙忙做着自己的事情。如果关于这个奇怪的星系有什么线索的话一定能在那里找到。
texts.en: The sole planet in the [From.Planet.System.GetName] system is bustling with drones. Heedless of us, they continue to perform their tasks. If the answers to this curious system are to be found anywhere, it is here.

sections.zh: [From.Planet.System.GetName]恒星系中孤零零的这颗行星上住满了无人机。它们对我们毫不关心，各自匆匆忙忙做着自己的事情。如果关于这个奇怪的星系有什么线索的话一定能在那里找到。
sections.en: The sole planet in the [From.Planet.System.GetName] system is bustling with drones. Heedless of us, they continue to perform their tasks. If the answers to this curious system are to be found anywhere, it is here.

notes.zh: 该星系在新游戏开始时有可能生成：隐藏事件 ancrel.12050（on_game_start）以 2:1:1 抽签——什么都不发生 / 向银河边缘（50–100距离）生成 surveillance_supercomputer_system（经 ancrel.12055）/ 若有《初次接触》且难度与AI设置允许则改为生成“被选中者”星系（fircon.3500，另一个故事）。系统里有“永恒守望者”势力的三支守卫舰队，遗址在行星“观测终端”上由初始化器创建（common/solar_system_initializers/special_system_initializers.txt:2024）。
notes.en: The system may be spawned when a game starts: hidden ancrel.12050 (on_game_start) draws 2 : 1 : 1 between nothing, spawning surveillance_supercomputer_system at the galactic rim (distance 50-100, via ancrel.12055), and — with First Contact and permitting difficulty/AI settings — spawning the Chosen system instead (fircon.3500, another story). The system holds the faction "Eternal Watchers" with three guard fleets; the site on the planet "Observation Terminal" is created by the initializer (common/solar_system_initializers/special_system_initializers.txt:2024).

texts.zh:
目前为止，我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]所能推断的是，这个被他们乌鸦嘴般称为“观测终端”的行星上从未有过生命的存在。但其上并不缺活动迹象。地表上有稠密的建筑物，大量人造建筑鳞次栉比地排列在荒芜的基岩上，这些规整的阵列几乎覆盖了行星四分之三的地表。数以亿计的无人机正在对其进行维护，执行的任务从简单的清扫到运行高度复杂的装配线皆包含在内。

然而它们的真正作用目前尚不明确。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]准备派遣一支队伍下到地表以进行进一步调查。
texts.en:
As far as our [Owner.GetResearchers] can tell, there has never been life on the planet they have ominously dubbed the "Observation Terminal". But there is no shortage of activity. The surface is densely built up, massive artificial structures placed upon the bare bedrock in neat, orderly rows that cover almost three quarters of the planet. Billions of mechanical drones maintain them, performing tasks ranging from menial clean-up to running highly-complex assembly lines.

Their exact purpose remains, however, unclear. Our [Owner.GetResearchers] are preparing to send a team to the surface to investigate further.

texts.zh:
这些机器人对我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]毫不关心，即使从它们的身边路过也继续执行着各自的命令。与这些无人机的一切沟通尝试都失败了，即便是尝试打断他们的工作也毫无收获，这些无人机毫不躲闪直接强行冲撞挡路的[Owner.GetResearchers]，造成了严重的损伤。

打那以后，我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]转而将目光放在操控这些无人机的程序上。通过分析拦截到的信号，我们推断其中有一个主宰一切的系统在操控这些无人机。然而，对其进行解码非常困难，可能很难再有进一步的发现了。
texts.en:
As our [Owner.GetResearchers] pass amongst them, the drones on the planet ignore their presence and continue going about their tasks. All efforts to communicate with the drones have failed, and even attempts to disrupt them produced no reactions - the drones simply rode roughshod over the interfering [Owner.GetResearchers], causing serious injury.

Since then, our [Owner.GetResearchers] have shifted their focus to the programs steering the drones. Analysis of intercepted signals suggests there is an overarching system steering them. However, the encryption it uses is extremely sophisticated, and it has proven hard to find out more.

texts.zh: 尽管我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]已经难以进一步深入调查这颗行星，但还有一支队伍还在继续研究散布在整个恒星系中的物体阵列。总共约有超过一万个这样的物体，它们大部分是长圆柱体外形的装置，似乎仍在运行，持续不断地向行星发送信号。鉴于它们的形状以及它们似乎无一例外地指向我们星系中的各个点的事实，我们无可避免地得出这是一个出奇巨大的传感器阵列的结论。但它会是由谁建造的呢？
texts.en: While our [Owner.GetResearchers] have been unable to make further progress investigating the planet, a team has been investigating the array of objects spread across the system. There are over ten thousand of them, all told. Most of them are long and cylindrical devices that still seem to be operating - they are transmitting a signal towards the planet. Given their shape and the fact that they seem to be without exception pointed towards various points in our galaxy, we cannot escape the conclusion that this is an absurdly huge sensor array. But who could have built it?

texts.zh: 在一次大胆的行动中，我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]趁着附近没有其他无人机存在时，成功地向一处无人机主机的接入终端植入了窃听装置。该入侵目前还没有被发现，我们对其的印象是这是一个高度复杂的系统，甚至可能远超我们的网络，但完全没有考虑到自卫的需求。毫无疑问他们认为这些防御舰队的武力吓止就已经非常充分了。尽管如此，我们入侵的这个系统庞大得难以置信，甚至庞大这个词用来描述这个涵盖整颗行星的系统来说都有些苍白无力，所以我们需要一些时间来获取更多信息。
texts.en: In a daring move, our [Owner.GetResearchers] managed to implant spyware into an access terminal to the drones' mainframe in a moment while no drones were nearby. The intrusion does not appear to have been detected yet. Our impression is of a highly sophisticated system - beyond even our own networks, probably - but one which did not anticipate the need to protect itself. No doubt the physical deterrence of the defense fleet was deemed sufficient. Nevertheless, the systems we are infiltrating are vast - a term which seems a gross understatement for this planetary system - so it will take some time to find out more.

texts.zh:
位于极域警哨的自动化系统似乎比我们所能想象的还要古老。我们黑入这个系统取得了数据，可是其中并没有能够帮助我们确认其建造者身份或最终意图的信息。关于系统的建造者，我们唯一可以确定的事情就是他们至少在12亿年前就已经来到了这里，在建造完系统并将其设定为监测整个星系的观测站后就离开了。

值得一提的是，经历如此漫长的岁月后，这个系统仍在运作。遍布整个系统的装置阵列实际上是高度精密的传感器，它们会向该星球发送实时数据，而在星球上的中央处理系统则会将这些数据转化为无人机可以保存并长期存储的数据。由于受到存储空间与物资短缺的影响，他们似乎下决心改进了数据压缩技术。这个星球上的巨型结构自称其存储了自建造以来的所有观测数据，不过我们却无法证实这一点，毕竟这些数据被过度压缩，已经超出我们的解压能力了。

令人不安的是，尽管发送频率下降，但其依旧在向外界广播“重点”数据流。不过都过了这么久了，应该也没人在监听了吧？不管怎样，我们已经准备好程序接管这些无人机，只要有胆量，我们马上就可以根据我们自己的设想改造这个系统。
texts.en:
It seems the automated systems in Ultima Vigilis are older than we can imagine. The data systems we have hacked do not give us any clues as to the identity or ultimate intentions of its creators, but the one thing we have managed to ascertain is that they arrived no less than 1.2 billion years ago, and departed soon after setting up the system as an observation post to surveil our entire galaxy.

Remarkably, the system is still operating even after all these years: the array of installations spread across the system are, it turns out, highly sophisticated sensors. They send a live feed to the planet, where the central operating system processes it into information the drones can save and store. Spurred on by shortages of space and matter, it appears that they have improved their data compression techniques with determination: the massive structures on the planet purport to contain the sum of all observations ever recorded. However, we cannot test this assertion, since the data is compressed well beyond our ability to decompress it.

Disturbingly, a reduced stream of "highlights" is still being broadcast into empty space. But surely no one is still listening, after all this time? Regardless, our programs are poised to take control of the drones. We may now shape the system to our imagination - if we dare.

label.zh: 我们可以将这一整颗星球整合进我们自己的操作系统。
label.en: We can integrate the world into our own operating system.

label.zh: 让它们继续，我们可以提取他们的数据。
label.en: Let them continue - we can siphon off their readings.

label.zh: 将这些无人机分发到我们的各个殖民地。
label.en: Distribute the drones to our colonies.

tooltips.zh: 8K£pop£ 机器人口将被分配到我们的各个殖民地上。
tooltips.en: 8K £pop£ Machine Pops are distributed to our colonies.

label.zh: 将这些无人机分发到我们的各个殖民地。
label.en: Distribute the drones to our colonies.

tooltips.zh: 8K£pop£ 机械人口将被分配到我们的各个殖民地上。
tooltips.en: 8K £pop£ Mechanical Pops are distributed to our colonies.

label.zh: 但这可是一个巨大的合金库啊！
label.en: But this is just an enormous alloy mine!

label.zh: 这个运作良好的网络可以为我们所用。
label.en: A well-organized network such as this could serve us well.

tooltips.zh: [From.Planet.System.GetName]星系将由一个机械智能国家管辖，该国家会成为我们的附庸国。他们的首都，[From.Planet.GetName]，将成为一颗带有8K£pop£机器人口的机械星球。
tooltips.en: The [From.Planet.System.GetName] system will be placed under the control of a Machine Intelligence that will be our subject. Their capital, [From.Planet.GetName], will be a Machine World with 8K £pop£ Machine Pops.

texts.zh:
“你们一点也不顾念——”

传输数据流乱码了一段时间，无法输出有效信息。

“你们难道没有想过有人正在接受那个你漫不经心就切断掉的数据流？行吧，既然你们已经证明自己是一群危险而具有攻击性的害虫……那么是时候叫害虫防治过来了。准备好迎接末日吧。”
texts.en:
"You inconsiderate-"

The transmission feed is garbled for a time, and no sense can be made of the noises heard.

"Did you never consider that someone might be watching that signal feed you so carelessly cut off? Well, since you have proven yourselves to be dangerously aggressive vermin... it's time to call the PEST CONTROL. Prepare to face your doom."

summary.text:
# 远古机器人星球 / Ancient Robot World

- 分类 Category：先驱者与考古 Precursors · 来源 Sources：common/archaeological_site_types/00_base_game_arc_sites.txt:194；events/ancient_relics_arcsite_events_2.txt:8641；common/solar_system_initializers/special_system_initializers.txt:2024 · DLC：《远古遗物》Ancient Relics（事件在 ancrel 文件；遗址定义在基础游戏文件） Ancient Relics events; site definition in the base-game file · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

该星系在新游戏开始时有可能生成：隐藏事件 ancrel.12050（on_game_start）以 2:1:1 抽签——什么都不发生 / 向银河边缘（50–100距离）生成 surveillance_supercomputer_system（经 ancrel.12055）/ 若有《初次接触》且难度与AI设置允许则改为生成“被选中者”星系（fircon.3500，另一个故事）。系统里有“永恒守望者”势力的三支守卫舰队，遗址在行星“观测终端”上由初始化器创建（common/solar_system_initializers/special_system_initializers.txt:2024）。

The system may be spawned when a game starts: hidden ancrel.12050 (on_game_start) draws 2 : 1 : 1 between nothing, spawning surveillance_supercomputer_system at the galactic rim (distance 50-100, via ancrel.12055), and — with First Contact and permitting difficulty/AI settings — spawning the Chosen system instead (fircon.3500, another story). The system holds the faction "Eternal Watchers" with three guard fleets; the site on the planet "Observation Terminal" is created by the initializer (common/solar_system_initializers/special_system_initializers.txt:2024).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

一颗从未有过生命、被数十亿机械无人机填满的行星，其周围一万多件圆筒状设备都指向银河各处——这是十二亿年前外来者留下的“监视银河”的观测站。先要在系统里面对“永恒守望者”的守卫舰队；挖掘的最后你可以黑进它，决定如何利用这套监控网络。

1. [From.GetName]恒星系：首次进入系统且守望者舰队在场：“战斗警报！”
2. [fromfrom.System.GetName]大捷：击毁守军后：“…大捷”，系统里几乎没有固体物质了
3. 攒动的人工生命：“观测终端”：行星从未有过生命，被机械无人机和整齐的人工结构覆盖
4. 无人机调查：无人机无视一切接触，甚至会撞伤研究者；转而分析无人机的控制程序
5. 恒星系探索：系统里一万多件圆筒设备在向银河各处发射信号
6. 钓鱼执法：在无人机附近植入间谍程序，系统庞大却毫无自卫

A lifeless planet crowded with billions of drones, ringed by over ten thousand cylinders pointed at the galaxy — an observation post left 1.2 billion years ago to spy on it. First its guard fleets must be faced; the dig ends with a hacked mainframe and a choice of how to use the surveillance network.

1. The [From.GetName] System: entering the system for the first time with the Watchers' fleets present: Battlestations!
2. Victory in [fromfrom.System.GetName]: after the defenders fall: Victory; almost no solid matter is left in the system
3. Teeming with Artificial Life: Observation Terminal: a lifeless planet covered in drones and orderly artificial structures
4. Investigating the Drones: drones ignore all contact and even injure researchers; the control programs become the focus
5. Systemic Exploration: over ten thousand cylinders beam signals to points across the galaxy
6. Time to Phish: spyware is implanted in a drone terminal; the system is vast and undefended

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 超级监察计算机 / The Surveillance Supercomputer：（Ultima Vigilis）：十二亿年前来客建立的观测站。五个选项：A（机器帝国）整合整颗星球为机械星球（80个人口、大型首都）；B 任其运转，监听其数据（在系统里恢复一个间谍球体巨型结构）；C 把无人机分发到己方殖民地（机械或机器人人口80）；D（唯心主义者）把它当成巨型合金矿（合金资源点）；E（非唯心主义者）把网络改造成一个机器智能附庸国“重新利用的监视网络”。A、C、D、E 各有50%概率在30天后触发 ancrel.12095 / (Ultima Vigilis): an observation post set up 1.2 billion years ago. Five options: A (machine empires) integrate the planet as a machine world (80 pops, a major capital); B let it run and siphon its readings (restores a spy-orb megastructure); C distribute drones to our colonies (80 machine or robot pops); D (spiritualists) treat it as an enormous alloy mine (an alloy deposit); E (non-spiritualists) turn the network into a machine-intelligence subject, "Repurposed Surveillance Network". A, C, D and E each have a 50% chance to fire ancrel.12095 thirty days later
- 信号传输接入 / Incoming Transmission：“你们这些粗心的……”：被你切断信号的幕后观察者宣布要召来“害虫防治”。设置全局标志 endgame_crisis_early_start，所有其他玩家国家收到 ancrel.12100 / "You inconsiderate-": the watchers whose feed you cut announce "pest control". The global flag endgame_crisis_early_start is set and every other player-type empire receives ancrel.12100
- 信号传输接入 / Incoming Transmission：其他帝国收到的同一条警告 / the same warning received by every other empire
- 选项 B 不会触发危机；其他选项（A、C、D、E）的50%概率意味着约半数游戏会因此提前开启终局危机。 / Option B never triggers the crisis; for A, C, D and E the 50% roll means about half of such playthroughs start the endgame crisis early.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 12090 的选项按帝国类型显示：A 仅机器帝国，C 有机器版与“允许机器人”版，D 仅唯心主义者，E 仅非唯心主义者。 / The options of 12090 are shown by empire: A for machine empires only, C in a machine and a "robots allowed" version, D for spiritualists only, E for non-spiritualists only.
- 本遗址的 on_roll_failed 使用 no_events：掷骰失败不触发随机意外。 / The site uses no_events: a failed roll triggers no incident.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：遗址定义（common/archaeological_site_types/00_base_game_arc_sites.txt:194）的阶段顺序与条件、各阶段事件脚本、出现方式；中英文正文已读。
- Checked: the site definition (common/archaeological_site_types/00_base_game_arc_sites.txt:194) with its stage order and conditions, every stage event script, and how the site appears; both languages read.
- 原先 12060、12065 是两个孤立的单事件故事；它们是进入该系统前后的战斗通知，现并入本故事作为开端。
- ancrel.12060 and 12065 were separate one-card stories; they are the battle notices before and after the dig and now open this story.
- 开局生成方式（ancrel.12050/12055）不在草稿中，现在作为说明补充。
- The game-start spawn (ancrel.12050/12055) was missing from the draft and is now documented.
